senses.gloss:
गै गै, i. 1, गाय (in epic poetry गान्ति, instead of गायन्ति, from the original form of the vb. गा), Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., Rām. 1, 62, 20).
 1. To sing, Man. 4, 64.
 2. To teach, Bhāg. P. 4, 21, 40 (3 pl. Aor. अगुस्).
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. गीत, Sung, Śāk. 4, 11. n. A song, Arj. 4, 10.
 --Comp.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. गेय, n. A song, Indr. 5, 27.
 --Caus. गापय,
 1. To cause to sing, Kathās. 12, 31.
 2. To cause to praise, Bhāg. P. 6, 17, 3. Frequent. जेगीय, To sing aloud, MBh. 12, 12200.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु,
 1. To sing in harmony with (with acc.), Gīt. 1, 39.
 2. To accompany with singing, MBh. 1, 7913.
 3. To sing, [] Bhāg. P. 6, 1, 60. Pass. अनु-गीय, To be spoken of in songs, MBh. 12, 4211.
 --With अभि अभि, To sing, Rām. 1, 4, 24. अभिगीत, Filled with song, Rām. 6, 15, 11.
 --With अव अव, in अवगीत, Detested, Kir. 2, 7.
 --With उद् उद्,
 1. To sing, Bhāg. P. 7, 4, 39.
 2. To celebrate by song, Ragh. 2, 12. उद्गीत, Filled with song, MBh. 3, 1533. n. song, MBh. 1, 6569.
 --With प्रोद् प्र-उद्, To begin to sing, Prab. 80, 3.
 --With उप उप,
 1. To sing before somebody (with the acc. of the pson.), MBh. 1, 4809; उपगीयन्त्, anomalous ptcple. of the pres. pass. MBh. 15, 883.
 2. To fill with song, MBh. 3, 11606.
 3. To celebrate by song, Rām. 4, 44, 57.
 4. To sing, Bhāg. P. 5, 14, 41. उपगीत Singing in the vicinity, Śiś. 4, 57.
 --With नि नि, निगीत, Canted, Man. 9, 19.
 --With परि परि, To sing round a person, MBh. 6, 75.
 2. To celebrate by song, MBh. 13, 4095.
 --With प्र प्र, To sing, Rām. 1, 4, 31. प्रगीत,
 1. Filled with song, Rām. 1, 9, 17.
 2. Singing, Kathās. 16, 85.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, To sing, MBh. 8, 1836.
 --With वि वि, विगीत,
 1. Inconsistent, contradictory, Man. 8, 53.
 2. Abused.
 3. Ill sung (i. e. गीत, with वि).
 --With सम् सम्, To celebrate by song, Bhāg. P. 3, 22, 23. संगीत, n.
 1. A concert, Megh. 57.
 2. Science of music and dancing, Lass. 67, 5.
